name: CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2023
information:
This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. For a more normal comeptition experience, check out [CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2023).

Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at [CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2023) during the award ceremony there.

This competition will take place at 4 different venues across the Southeast. Check out the Location Tab for more details.
